params.1273: Burn a shade using a pyre log of any sort.
params.1274: To make a pyre log, you require a log and a dose of sanctified olive oil.
params.1275: Olive oil can be sanctified during the Shades of Mort'ton quest or activity.
params.1276: You will also need the corpse of a shade. Place it and the logs on a bier and light the logs with a tinderbox.
params.1277: Don't forget to collect your reward next to the bier.
